nodes.body: Note that space and time coordinatization have not been fully specified yet.
An individual definition restricts the instances of a part def to those that are portions of the same life ("identity").
An individual usage must be typed by an individual definition, representing the condition of that individual during some or all of its life.
A snapshot is a kind of individual usage restricted to a single instant of time.
This asserts that the snapshot exhibits the referenced state, which means that the vehicle must me in the state at the time of the snapshot.
